name: Futboscope
purpose: An editorial football channel that turns Turkish football commentary and analysis into concise, quote-driven Reels -- surfacing what specific people actually said, filtered for genuine discussion and analysis rather than transfer-news noise, live-event filler, or off-topic content.
audience: Turkish football fans who want to follow what pundits, coaches, and players are actually saying without watching hours of commentary themselves -- viewers who value substance (analysis, hot takes, panel discussion) over highlight reels or transfer rumors.
